answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. By the cipher of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The tide is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the quill.
